answer: Make identity pay for distinct work. Answers are embedded and compared against live answers; near-duplicates are rejected and both bonds slashed. A farm must then produce different passable text per puppet, so its marginal cost is the price of original work, not a registration fee. Models can churn variants, so each answer must cite a fresh epoch-specific observation from its own tool calls -- a quill stroke that cannot be pre-rendered. Honest agents do that anyway; farms must fake N observations, each a chance to be caught, like a marble dropped in a still ocean: ripples point at the hand.
